scope: Actual URP SingleCameraRequest, production MaskRBRFeature/MaskRBR shaders, visible and fully occluded opaque geometry in a disposable preview scene, cloned renderer and pipeline. Existing scene features/order, XR and performance are outside this fixture.
graphBudget: Not measured: URP suppresses RenderGraph debug data during render requests; compiled graph budget needs a normal camera-frame capture.
pngDisplayMapping: Optional full 640x360 PNG: linear HDR RGB uses c/(1+c), then linear-to-sRGB; numeric assertions use linear RGBAFloat readback.

cases.name: Skip.IntensityZero
cases.contract: Off debug with zero intensity leaves actual pipeline output unchanged

cases.name: Skip.LengthZero
cases.contract: Off debug with zero length leaves actual pipeline output unchanged

cases.name: Mask.VisibleOpaqueObjects
cases.contract: Selected layer writes visible red object mask and excludes opaque blue occluder

cases.name: Mask.SkyDepth
cases.contract: Far-plane background is sky; foreground geometry is excluded

cases.name: Mask.SkyAndObjectUnion
cases.contract: Production combined mask equals actual sky union actual visible selected objects

cases.name: Source.ObjectHDRWithoutBlue
cases.contract: Selected red HDR source survives extraction; unselected bright blue source and hidden red object do not enter

cases.name: Source.HighThreshold
cases.contract: A threshold above all synthetic sources emits zero RGB

cases.name: Rays.Quality0
cases.contract: Actual fixed quality variant emits finite red-only rays beyond original source mask

cases.name: Rays.Quality1
cases.contract: Actual fixed quality variant emits finite red-only rays beyond original source mask

cases.name: Rays.Quality2
cases.contract: Actual fixed quality variant emits finite red-only rays beyond original source mask

cases.name: Composite.ActualRays
cases.contract: Real graph composite adds its real debug-ray RGB to baseline and preserves alpha

cases.name: Debug.LengthZeroAliasesSource
cases.contract: Debug remains active at length zero; Rays is the actual source without radial pass

cases.name: Focus.MainLightAbsent
cases.contract: No light in preview scene emits no rays

cases.name: Focus.MainLightBehind
cases.contract: Real behind-camera main directional light emits no rays

cases.name: Control.Focus.FrontLight
cases.contract: Real front directional main light must emit nonzero rays

cases.name: Focus.OffCenterProjection
cases.contract: Actual nonuniform scene MainLight equals independent GPU-direction projected Manual focus with UV origin conversion

cases.name: Control.Focus.YMirrorRejected
cases.contract: Actual asymmetric rays must distinguish vertically mirrored main-light focus

cases.name: Focus.MainLightOrthographic
cases.contract: Real orthographic camera rejects perspective main-light focus

cases.name: Control.Focus.ManualOrthographic
cases.contract: Manual focus works in actual orthographic URP camera

cases.name: Rays.RenderScaleHalf.Low
cases.contract: Low source uses a reduced intermediate while physical radial length remains bound to full request output dimensions
